title: OL-20261118-5: REGEN-PUSH-401: regen-generated push_main returns read main 401
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** next merge to main
**Done check:** grep:.github/workflows/regen-generated.yml::push_main
**Status:** open

After PR 673 merged, regen-generated failed 4 tries: push_main HTTP 502, read main 401 from the tick Worker route. Generated counts stayed stale on main. Probe the route credential server-side and re-run regen.

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-19T08:34:23Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists
